verses.original: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד מִזְמֽוֹר׃ קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ miz·mō·wr qaw·wōh qiw·wî·ṯî Yah·weh way·yêṭ ’ê·lay way·yiš·ma‘ šaw·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David I waited patiently for . . . the LORD He inclined to me and heard my cry
verses.literalPt: Esperei com paciência por Jeová; ele se inclinou para mim e ouviu o meu clamor por socorro.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי׀ מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֪יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל־ סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lê·nî mib·bō·wr šā·’ō·wn miṭ·ṭîṭ hay·yā·wên way·yā·qem ‘al- se·la‘ raḡ·lay kō·w·nên ’ă·šu·rāy
verses.literal: He lifted me up from the pit of despair out of the miry clay He set my feet upon a rock and made my footsteps firm
verses.literalPt: Também me tirou duma cova de perdição, dum tremedal de lama; colocou os meus pés sobre uma rocha e firmou os meus passos.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י׀ שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên bə·p̄î šîr ḥā·ḏāš tə·hil·lāh lê·lō·hê·nū yir·’ū rab·bîm wə·yî·rā·’ū wə·yiḇ·ṭə·ḥū Yah·weh
verses.literal: He put a new song in my mouth a hymn of praise to our God Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pôs um novo cântico na minha boca, hino de louvor ao nosso Deus. Muitos verão isso, temerão e confiarão em Jeová.

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא־ פָנָ֥ה אֶל־ רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê hag·ge·ḇer ’ă·šer- śām Yah·weh miḇ·ṭa·ḥōw wə·lō- p̄ā·nāh ’el- rə·hā·ḇîm wə·śā·ṭê ḵā·zāḇ
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust who has not turned to the proud nor to those who lapse into falsehood
verses.literalPt: Feliz é o homem que faz de Jeová a sua confiança e não se vira para os arrogantes e para os apóstatas mentirosos.

verses.original: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ׀ אַתָּ֤ה׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין׀ עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯe·ḵā ū·maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā ’ê·lê·nū ’ên ‘ă·rōḵ ’ê·le·ḵā ’ag·gî·ḏāh wa·’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh ‘ā·ṣə·mū mis·sap·pêr
verses.literal: Many O LORD my God are the wonders You have done and the plans You have for us none can compare to You if I proclaim and declare them they are more than I can count
verses.literalPt: Muitas são, Jeová, Deus meu, as tuas maravilhas que tens feito e bem assim os teus pensamentos para conosco. Ninguém há que se possa comparar a ti. Se eu quisesse declará-los e deles falar, são mais do que se podem contar.

verses.original: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה׀ לֹֽא־ חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ze·ḇaḥ ū·min·ḥāh lō- ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā ’ā·zə·na·yim kā·rî·ṯā lî ‘ō·w·lāh wa·ḥă·ṭā·’āh lō šā·’ā·lə·tā
verses.literal: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire but my ears You have opened Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require
verses.literalPt: Em sacrifícios e em ofertas de cereais, não te deleitas; abriste-me os ouvidos; holocaustos e ofertas pelo pecado, não os exigiste.

verses.original: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־ בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־ סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי׃
verses.literal: Then I said Here I am I have come it is written about me in the scroll . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, disse eu: Eis que venho; no rolo do livro, está escrito a meu respeito.

verses.original: לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת־ רְצוֹנְךָ֣ אֱלֹהַ֣י חָפָ֑צְתִּי וְ֝ת֥וֹרָתְךָ֗ בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·śō·wṯ- rə·ṣō·wn·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hay ḥā·p̄ā·ṣə·tî wə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯə·ḵā bə·ṯō·wḵ mê·‘āy
verses.literal: I delight to do Your will O my God Your law is within my heart
verses.literalPt: Em fazer a tua vontade, Deus meu, eu me deleito; a tua lei está dentro do meu coração.

verses.original: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק׀ בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.transliteration: biś·śar·tî ṣe·ḏeq bə·qā·hāl rāḇ hin·nêh śə·p̲ā·t̲ai lō ’eḵ·lā Yah·weh ’at·tāh yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā
verses.literal: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly behold I do not seal my lips as You O LORD do know
verses.literalPt: Proclamei boas-novas de justiça nas grandes congregações; eis que não fechei os meus lábios. Tu, Jeová, o sabes.

verses.original: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא־ כִסִּ֨יתִי׀ בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא־ כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā lō- ḵis·sî·ṯî bə·ṯō·wḵ lib·bî ’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯə·ḵā ū·ṯə·šū·‘ā·ṯə·ḵā ’ā·mā·rə·tî lō- ḵi·ḥaḏ·tî ḥas·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mit·tə·ḵā lə·qā·hāl rāḇ
verses.literal: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly
verses.literalPt: Não ocultei dentro do meu coração a tua justiça; declarei a tua fidelidade e a tua salvação. Não escondi da grande congregação a tua benignidade e a tua verdade.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא־ תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh Yah·weh lō- ṯiḵ·lā ra·ḥă·me·ḵā mim·men·nî ḥas·də·ḵā wa·’ă·mit·tə·ḵā tā·mîḏ yiṣ·ṣə·rū·nî
verses.literal: O LORD do not withhold Your mercy from me Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me
verses.literalPt: Tu, Jeová, não me retirarás as tuas ternas misericórdias; a tua benignidade e a tua verdade sempre me guardarão.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ־ עָלַ֨י׀ רָע֡וֹת עַד־ אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־ יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·p̄ə·p̄ū- ‘ā·lay rā·‘ō·wṯ ‘aḏ- ’ên mis·pār hiś·śî·ḡū·nî ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯay wə·lō- yā·ḵō·lə·tî lir·’ō·wṯ ‘ā·ṣə·mū miś·śa·‘ă·rō·wṯ rō·šî wə·lib·bî ‘ă·zā·ḇā·nî
verses.literal: For evils . . . without number surround me . . . my sins have overtaken me so that I cannot . . . see They are more than the hairs of my head and my heart has failed within me
verses.literalPt: Pois me cercaram males inumeráveis; as minhas iniquidades me alcançaram, e não posso ver; são mais que os cabelos da minha cabeça, e o meu coração me desamparou.

verses.original: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ṣêh Yah·weh lə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî Yah·weh lə·‘ez·rā·ṯî ḥū·šāh
verses.literal: Be pleased O LORD to deliver me hurry O LORD to help me
verses.literalPt: Digna-te, Jeová, livrar-me; dá-te pressa, Jeová, em me socorrer.

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ׀ יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū wə·yaḥ·pə·rū ya·ḥaḏ mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šî lis·pō·w·ṯāh yis·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·yik·kā·lə·mū ḥă·p̄ê·ṣê rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded . . . may those who wish me harm be repelled . . . and humiliated
verses.literalPt: Sejam, à uma, envergonhados e confundidos aqueles que buscam tirar-me a vida; sejam obrigados a voltar atrás e cubram-se de ignomínia aqueles que folgam com o meu mal.

verses.original: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל־ עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀ הֶאָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: yā·šōm·mū ‘al- ‘ê·qeḇ bā·šə·tām hā·’ō·mə·rîm lî he·’āḥ he·’āḥ
verses.literal: May those who say to me Aha aha be appalled at . . . their own shame
verses.literalPt: Fiquem desolados em razão da sua vergonha os que me dizem: Ah! Ah!

verses.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־ מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śî·śū wə·yiś·mə·ḥū bə·ḵā kāl- mə·ḇaq·še·ḵā yō·mə·rū ṯā·mîḏ yiḡ·dal Yah·weh ’ō·hă·ḇê tə·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You may those who love Your salvation always say The LORD be magnified
verses.literalPt: Folguem e regozijem-se em ti todos os que te buscam. Digam continuamente os que amam a tua salvação: Magnificado seja Jeová!

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־ תְּאַחַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ’ă·ḏō·nāy ya·ḥă·šāḇ lî ‘ez·rā·ṯî ū·mə·p̄al·ṭî ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay ’al- tə·’a·ḥar
verses.literal: But I am poor and needy may the Lord think of me You are my helper and deliverer O my God do not delay
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a mim, pobre e necessitado, o Senhor cuida de mim. Tu és o meu amparo e o meu libertador; Não tardes, Deus meu.
